prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original grounded medieval RPG LOW RES PIXEL ART location review concept, elevated three-quarter cutaway. Chunky hard square pixel clusters, selective dark outlines, restrained three-tone stone timber linen iron, muted earth palette, no smooth painting or photorealism. No people, no readable text, no quest UI, no magic, no claimed outcome. Modest practical scale, no giant fantasy architecture. Open ordinary return path clearly visible. Geometry is a proposal, not certified collision or inventory. One small coastal village fish-sharing smokehouse by a low stone wind wall. ONE modest partially filled basket of a single shift's fish on a low table, one EMPTY separate basket; movable simple cooking/smoking rack next to a cold stone hearth. Finite fuel bundle; only a small loose net patch on wall well away from hearth, no giant net curtain. Open dry courtyard exit on BOTH sides of smokehouse, unobstructed by rack or baskets. No fish replenishment, feast, eviction, verdict, paid settlement or restored houses. Focus finite catch and movable shared hearth.
